mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.end_type, r.built_in, r.sort, r.description, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.creator, r.updater, r.deleted, r.version FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.end_type IN ('both', #{end})
SELECT id, code, name, end_type, built_in, sort, description, create_time, update_time, creator, updater, deleted, version FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
